description: Works to trees covered by LBE ORDER NO 68: (T1) lime - reduce by up to 3m back to previous pruning points, (T2) oak - cut back by 2m from the building.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

a. The works hereby approved shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'. b. For the lime tree, no previous pruning points shall be exceeded and the works shall be strictly limited to a crown reduction of the re-growth around the periphery of the crown only. No pruning works shall take place elsewhere in the crown. All growth within the internal crown structure shall be left in situ, in order to provide the tree with leaf bearing structure wherewith it can continue its physiological processes after the works hereby approved.c. For the oak tree, the works shall only constitute the minimum pruning necessary to lateral growth on the northern side of the crown only, to achieve up to 2m clearance between the building and the remaining foliage.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved trees.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
